description: What is owed for one or more benefit periods (types TT total, TP partial with a disability %, RE reduced earnings with weekly earnings), the way The Comp Desk's CCP/Award calculator works it out: weeks from the dates (both ends count; a period starting the day the last ended counts it once; weeks rounded down to the tenth by default), each period's rate within the max and min, and the total award. With prior_payments (0 if none) it adds the claimant's money, the 15% fee exact to the cent, the OC-400.1 amount rounded down to $5 and the net; an employer reimbursement out of the whole award is split as on SLU. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core (the engine behind the app, the website calculators and the Pro Workspace); it never estimates. If an input is missing it returns status "missing" with every input still needed and calculates nothing. Returns the figures, the rate year used, the formulas with their citations (each flagged with whether it has been attorney-reviewed), and the not-legal-advice notice.

aww.description: Average weekly wage before the injury, in dollars (gross).

date_of_accident.description: Date of accident (injury), YYYY-MM-DD. Only a full date the user gave; never a guessed one.

employer_reimbursement.description: Optional employer reimbursement (REIMB ER) out of the award: { "amount": dollars } or { "amount_unknown": true } when it is still TBD. Needs prior_payments (0 if none).

current_weekly_earnings.description: RE only: weekly earnings during the period.

disability_percent.description: TP only: degree of disability, 0–100 (50 means 50%).

prior_counsel_fees.description: Optional. Dollar amount of the fee apportioned to each prior counsel (one or two). The current attorney gets the rest of the fee.

prior_payments.description: Optional: dollars already paid on these periods (0 if none). Adds the fee and net.

name: calculate_ccp_award
title: NY award for benefit periods (CCP)
